NEOW.talk.MUMYEONG-MUMYEONG_CHARACTER.0-: ...You smell of a heart that stopped.
It stopped. It beats again now.
Then take a blessing of mine. I do not know who waits for you below.
NEOW.talk.MUMYEONG-MUMYEONG_CHARACTER.1-: Back again. Whose soul walks with you this time?
I won't know until the film rolls.
NEOW.talk.MUMYEONG-MUMYEONG_CHARACTER.2-: However many times you die, you come back, nameless child.
There are still people in the seats.
